items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Yeah, over here. Pascal Bono. Right, right. They all are basically the same.

ctx.x: A lot of people use Italian Sol Feds.

Yeah, over here. Pascal Bono. Right, right. They all are basically the same. In fact, it is basically the same. Now that the print might be a little different. Or maybe some of the notes might, I mean, the formation of the notes might look a little different. But basically it is the Sol Feds is the same way anywhere you're going. It's the beginning of music, what music is. And a lot of these fellas there, you tell them Sol Feds, they don't know what you're talking about. You ask them what is music, they can't…
